hook: Weekly recap: how Bitcoin's supply really works.

scenes.narration: The subsidy went from fifty to three point one two five bitcoin across four halvings.
The real ceiling is just under twenty-one million, because of rounding.
The subsidy is expected to reach zero around twenty one forty. Then only fees.

cta: Which fact was new? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Weekly Recap: Bitcoin Supply and Rewards
description_body: Halvings, the real cap and the 2140 end of the subsidy.
